client_alerts.headline: Copilot in SharePoint can now send email on a user's behalf
client_alerts.body: Microsoft's October SharePoint update lets Copilot send email for the user, and agentic/at-scale work in SharePoint and OneDrive moves to usage-based billing. Clients with M365 Copilot should confirm who can trigger outbound mail from an agent, whether DLP and sensitivity labels apply to those sends, and set a credit cap before the **Dec 1** billing default lands.

top_moves.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026: GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth of Astra's price, plus a Decisions API
top_moves.body: GPT-6.1 Sol ($2 in / $10 out per MTok, $0.10 cached) is pitched as approaching GPT-6 Astra on agentic coding, computer use and professional work; it is live in the API, ChatGPT Work and Codex. DevDay also brought computer use in the Agents API, cloud Codex environments, persistent 'Dots' agents and a limited-preview Decisions API for fixed-answer classification and routing.

top_moves.title: Microsoft splits Copilot into two billing tracks; usage-based billing becomes the default for new CSP Business seats on Dec 1
top_moves.body: New Microsoft 365 Copilot Business subscriptions bought through CSP get usage-based billing on by default from **Dec 1**, with a 4,000 Copilot Credits per user per month limit that admins can change. The app is also rebuilt around a new Home screen, Code, and an always-on agent called Autopilot.

top_moves.title: xAI retires grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 and Grok 4.7 reaches Google's enterprise agent tooling
top_moves.body: As of Oct 2 all transcribe-1.0 requests route to grok-voice-transcribe-2.0 at the same price. Enterprises outside the X/xAI ecosystem can now reach Grok 4.7 through Google's enterprise agent tooling, and Musk claimed major speed improvements on Oct 1.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: DevDay 2026: GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth of Astra's price, Agents API computer use, cloud Codex, Dots, and a Decisions API preview
providers.detail: GPT-6.1 Sol is priced at $2 input / $0.10 cached input / $10 output per million tokens and is available in the API, ChatGPT Work and Codex. The Agents API gains computer use, multi-agent support, tool search and context compaction on an OpenAI-managed backend. Codex adds cloud environments, PR/MR review for GitHub and GitLab, and Codex Security Cloud repository scanning. Consumer ChatGPT added virtual try-on, product Favorites and multi-page document scanning to PDF on iOS.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Follow-through on Claude Code mods: plugin developer portal with review tracking and usage analytics; CLI gains --desktop and ultracode mode
providers.detail: Developers can now submit plugins to the Claude directory through a new developer portal, follow them through review and see usage analytics once live. Claude Code docs updated Oct 2 show a --desktop flag and an ultracode argument for /effort (v2.1.284+). Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 remain the headline models; no new model today.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Gemini 4 Argon (Sept 30) is still gated to Fairwind cyber defenders and internal teams — no model ID, regions or date for Vertex yet
providers.detail: Google says Argon goes next to paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers, then developers, enterprises and consumers, but has given no date. The model is in the U.S. government's voluntary pre-release evaluation process. Nothing new shipped today.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 reaches end of life (Oct 2); Grok 4.7 becomes reachable through Google's enterprise agent tooling
providers.detail: All transcribe-1.0 requests now route to grok-voice-transcribe-2.0 at the same price with higher accuracy. Musk announced major Grok speed improvements on Oct 1. Grok 4.7 (500k context) remains the current API model; Grok 5 is still in training with no date.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Quiet — Muse Spark 1.3 (Sept 2) remains the latest release
providers.detail: No new Muse or Llama release found. The Llama line ended when Muse Spark replaced it in April.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Enterprise migration to the simpler Vibe experience opened Oct 1; admins pick their date within a roughly six-month window
providers.detail: The Admin Panel also has User and Permissions Management for assigning members to workspaces and bulk-assigning permissions via groups. No new model today.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Quiet — Computer in Spaces is the latest; HP ZBook Ultra G3a preinstall is expected this month
providers.detail: No new release found today. The HP device rollout starts with the ZBook Ultra G3a in October, with more HP Windows devices to follow.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot splits into two billing tracks; usage-based billing on by default for new CSP Business seats from Dec 1; SharePoint Copilot can send email
providers.detail: The default spending limit is 4,000 Copilot Credits per user per month, adjustable by admins. Copilot in SharePoint and OneDrive reach GA with everyday features on the standard licence and agentic/at-scale work on usage billing. PowerPoint Copilot can keep working on long-running tasks after the user leaves, and the app is rebuilt around Home, Code and an always-on Autopilot agent.
providers.alertReason: Agent-sent email from SharePoint plus default usage-based billing from Dec 1

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Copilot CLI 1.0.91 (Oct 1): sandbox commands work on Windows, new certificate management controls
providers.detail: A maintenance release following 1.0.89 (Sept 28), which added support for Claude Code rule files. No change today to the desktop computer-use and multi-agent workflow features covered yesterday.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: Quiet — Rollouts and Security Review bots (Sept 23) are still the latest
providers.detail: No new Cursor release found today.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Still no feature release — only a mobile app 1.0.7 sign-in/CAPTCHA fix
providers.detail: No product release found; the long quiet stretch since June 12 continues.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: AI Search is 50% faster; JS SDK 5.27.0 adds client.plugins and client.skills; Skills library and Custom Agents sub-agents remain the headline
providers.detail: notion-ai-search now accepts the same filters and sort options as notion-search and allows an empty query for filter-only browsing. The SDK adds typed databases and signed archive URLs for plugins and skills. Incremental, not a new launch.

persistent_signals.text: Meta — no release since Muse Spark 1.3 (Sept 2) — 2 weeks running in the headline
Cursor — Rollouts and Security Review bots (Sept 23) still the latest — 2 weeks running
Gamma — no feature release since June 12 — 2+ weeks running (about 113 days quiet)
Notion AI — team Skills library still the headline — 2 weeks running
Microsoft 365 Copilot — cost visibility and usage-based billing — 2 weeks running (model picker and cost view last week, default usage billing this week)

month_themes.then: Frontier cyber capability gating (Astra crosses OpenAI's 'Critical' threshold); Claude Fable 5.1 pricing and phased rollout; waiting on Grok 4.7
month_themes.now: Cheaper near-frontier agents (GPT-6.1 Sol at one-fifth of Astra); metered agent billing arriving in Microsoft 365 Copilot; Gemini 4 Argon held behind a cyber-defender gate

habits.shift: No change. Long-context drafting stays on Opus 5.5; try GPT-6.1 Sol only as a cheaper second-pass reviewer.
No change. Keep clause-level claims verified against the source standard.
When comparing AI vendors for clients, add GPT-6.1 Sol's $2/$10 pricing and Gemini 4 Argon's undated enterprise access to the matrix.
For M365 clients, add a line item for Copilot Credit caps and usage-billing governance ahead of Dec 1.
PowerPoint Copilot now keeps working after you leave the app — worth a trial for long deck builds; Gamma still has nothing new.

habits.task: Client advisory on AI data risk
habits.shift: Add 'agents that send email or act while you are away' (SharePoint Copilot, Autopilot, OpenAI Dots) to the client risk checklist: who authorises, what is logged, how it is switched off.

community.signal: Kimi K3 weights released (about 3.2k points, 638 comments) tops the week, with the 'open-weights carousel never stops' threads close behind.
community.so_what: Open-weight models keep closing on frontier quality — relevant for clients who need an on-prem or air-gapped fallback in a continuity plan.

community.signal: DeepSeek-V4-Flash update thread (about 1.4k points): locally runnable models now match the top frontier score from March 2026; V4-Pro said to follow soon.
community.so_what: A credible offline option for sensitive document work is about six months behind the frontier, not years.

community.signal: Two high-engagement threads (about 1.1k–1.2k points, 400+ comments each) object to proposed requirements on open-weight models, including one aimed at Anthropic's policy position.
community.so_what: Regulatory pressure on open weights is a planning risk if a client's resilience design depends on self-hosted models.

community.signal: No reliably sourced top threads surfaced in search this run.
community.so_what: Nothing to act on; treat as no signal rather than quiet.

watch.title: Copilot usage-based billing default — Dec 1
watch.body: New CSP Copilot Business seats get usage billing on by default at 4,000 credits per user per month. Set caps and reporting before then.

watch.title: Gemini 4 Argon general access
watch.body: Paid API and AI Ultra come first; no model ID, regions or date yet. Watch for the Vertex listing.

watch.title: OpenAI Decisions API leaves limited preview
watch.body: Fixed-answer classification and routing on the smaller Luna model — a possible fit for incident triage and ticket routing once it opens up.

watch.title: Mistral Vibe enterprise migration window
watch.body: Opened Oct 1; admins choose their date within about six months. Clients on Le Chat Enterprise should schedule it rather than be defaulted.

watch.title: Agents that act unattended
watch.body: SharePoint Copilot sending email, Copilot Autopilot, OpenAI Dots and Agents API computer use all landed within days. Expect audit-logging and admin-control details to follow; review before enabling.
